scope.input_documents: Only the 27 PDFs directly inside authorized test/forms folder

source_freeze.provenance: Parent declared train source frozen before held-out authorization. This census did not read frozen-reader extracted values.

source_catalog.use: Frozen source field definitions and source-field choice codes only; no answer data

method.comparison_normalization: Unicode NFKC, case folding, alphanumeric label matching; raw PDF hashes retained
method.choice_family_definition: One printed source field is one family. A checkbox group counts once regardless of options. Each matrix row counts once. Completion status counts once. SourceField consolidates expanded checkbox export columns.
method.visible_family_method: The same source-label census method established on train. Match complete printed labels to catalog source fields; bound repeated personal/family and CSF stage labels by explicit sections. Missing printed questions are absent, not blank answers. The sole CSF B label alias was established on train. No held-out extraction rules were added.
method.identity_method: Group by exact printed Record ID. Compare separately parsed first name, last name, DOB, and MRN as strings with Unicode/case/outer-space normalization. Preserve MRN leading zeros. Raw demographics omitted from this artifact.
method.native_geometry_check: Independently count drawn checkbox squares and radio circles from PDF path operations. Compare their total option counts to matched visible catalog families. Geometry mismatches are recorded as failures without modifying the frozen reader.

selection_patterns.radio: The PDF draws empty circles as vectors. Selected circles include Unicode ● text. A matrix mark column x-coordinate carries the value; flattened text order does not.
selection_patterns.checkbox: The PDF draws empty squares as vectors. Selected squares contain ✓, ✔, ✗, or literal X text. These are selected-mark styles; a cross is not a false/No answer.
selection_patterns.numeric_and_text: Entries are native PDF text, including numeric values. This census does not decode answer values, infer numbers from glyphs, or use answer keys.
selection_patterns.blank: Unmarked visible radio families are counted separately. Do not convert absent or unseen checkbox fields to zero.
selection_patterns.unicode: NFKC resolves source ligatures such as ﬁ and ﬂ in labels and DSM footer.
selection_patterns.metadata_absent: No explicit repeat instance or data access group is printed.

limitations: Held-out source-form census only. Independent of frozen-reader expected values, all answer keys, and manifest.pdf. It does not measure answer extraction accuracy.
Counts refer to visible printed choice families, including unmarked rows. Reference catalog counts include conditionally absent fields.
Source-field metadata contains known clipped/unreadable option wording. Missing wording and numeric values were not invented.
All held-out pages were inspected through native text and PDF structure. No held-out source page was rendered for this census.
